summary: Banco Bradesco S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, disclosing August 2026 securities and derivatives transactions by its board of directors, executive officers, audit committee and controlling group/family dependants. Most entities reported no month movement; one group disclosed 7,000 non-voting share buys at roughly R$17.11-17.66 and 76,957 sales at roughly R$16.17-17.28, plus a 1,080-share lending debit. Opening and closing balances are largely unchanged, with no stake change, no terms and nothing for risk arbitrage.
